group_definition: 160 geometry-level spatial groups; four users per geometry; no user reuse; minimum group-center distance 10 m and minimum intra-geometry user distance 20 m
independence_basis: Development-only ASU Campus ray-tracing set reused from the v9-v12 development workflow; no independent-test claim is made for this dataset
channel_normalization: none; absolute DeepMIMO channel scale retained
cautions: This is development data and must not be reported as an independent V13 test.
Disjoint user indices and spatial separation do not prove independent channel episodes.
